_doc: Stage 1 story beats. Objectives are shown as quiet journal notes (never waypoints). Triggers run actions when conditions are met: flags (all), logsRead (min count), near [x,z,r], time [from,to], once.

objectives.text: Teo left a recorder in the flat upstairs. Find it.
Something glints in the flooded basement under the lobby. Dive for it (Space in water).
Smoke to the south-east: Portage. Divers dock at the red lamp.
Teo said Bram has his bag. Rusthold's tender is south of Portage.
Listen on 3.3 after dark (R on the boat radio).
The Keeper, on Portage's Vigil Mission deck, reads numbers like scripture.
The Sounding. Lower the Lowlight hydrophone. At night, if you must.

do.whisper: Cold. The boat rocks. The tower is silent above you.
To the north, on the horizon: Highmark. Still dry. Still lit.
The water here is black. The seabed simply stops.
Night. Lanterns on the rafts. One lamp burning in a far tower window.
Voices. Hammering. Somebody is cooking. Portage.
On Portage they are lighting paper lanterns and setting them on the water. One for each name.
Fog rolls in fast. Somewhere in it, a big engine. A searchlight smears across the white. Cut your engine (C) and get behind something.
The wind turns. Every rope on Portage starts to sing.

sideThreads.text: Ward 9's flooded basement, where Teo says the growth comes up. A rope and hook would reach the window.
Lantern night on Portage at dusk. Write a name on the paper.
The red lamp, or a tag that lets you tie up with everyone else. Sal and Madam Vance both sell a way up.
Low Row tore loose in the storm. Bring it home.
